//: The suite's time budgets (docs/testing.md, "Pruning: when a budget is hit"; docs/dev-machine.md, "Tiers"), read by scripts/test.ts and scripts/tiers.test.ts. The gate fails when the sum of its files' own times (file-seconds) is over file_seconds_total, or any file is over file_seconds: each file's time, not the run's wall, so a merge never fails because the machine was busy. The slow tier warns over its wall time. Set 2026-10-25 on the Mini (14 cores, 12 slots): the whole gate tier took 727 to 958 file-seconds as the load varied (the most, 958, with three agents and CI running), so 1,200 is that and about 25%; the slow tier on this branch 821 s of wall (2026-10-24), so 1,000. Raising one is a decision with its entry in docs/decisions.md.
